data.name: RefusalBusy
data.value: Something is already being done on this record. Try again in a moment.

data.name: RefusalCapacity
data.value: This record cannot take more changes right now. Try again later; if it persists, contact support.

data.name: RefusalChangedElsewhere
data.value: This record was changed while you were working on it. Refresh the page and try again.

data.name: RefusalDependents
data.value: Records depend on this GSKU, or one is being created under it. Retire them or wait until they are finished.

data.name: RefusalForbidden
data.value: You do not have permission for this action.

data.name: RefusalInternal
data.value: An unexpected inconsistency stopped this action; nothing was changed. Please contact support.

data.name: RefusalInvalidRequest
data.value: The request is not valid. Check the fields and try again.

data.name: RefusalNotFound
data.value: The record was not found, or you cannot see it.

data.name: RefusalNotRequester
data.value: Only the person who submitted this approval can withdraw it.

data.name: RefusalPackInvalid
data.value: The pack quantity or unit is not valid. Correct them and try again.

data.name: RefusalParentNotReady
data.value: The global product is not approved, or it can no longer be referenced.

data.name: RefusalReconciliation
data.value: This request is waiting for a specialist's review and stays as it is until then. Please contact support.

data.name: RefusalRepeatDiffers
data.value: This request was already sent with different details. Refresh the page and start again.

data.name: RefusalRequestEnded
data.value: The request ended without being applied. Start it again if it is still needed.

data.name: RefusalResubmit
data.value: The request did not reach the approval service. Send the same request again.

data.name: RefusalRetirementInProgress
data.value: This GSKU is being retired.

data.name: RefusalSelfApproval
data.value: The request was decided by its own submitter, so the decision was not applied.

data.name: RefusalServiceUnavailable
data.value: A service this action needs is not available right now. Try again in a moment.

data.name: RefusalSessionExpired
data.value: Your session was not accepted by the approval service. Sign in again and repeat the action.

data.name: RefusalSetupIncomplete
data.value: The approval setup for this action is incomplete. Please inform your administrator.

data.name: RefusalManualReconciliation
data.value: The approval service and this record do not agree, and repeating the request did not settle it. It stays as it is until someone reconciles it; please contact your administrator.

data.name: RefusalClosedWithoutDecision
data.value: The approval was closed without a decision (cancelled or expired). The draft can be edited and submitted again.

data.name: InfoRetiredAfterApproval
data.value: A unit used by this GSKU was retired after the approval. The approval stands: it was applied with the values validated when it was submitted; the retired unit cannot be chosen for new records.

data.name: RefusalStockFlagsRequired
data.value: Set lot control in this GSKU's stock behaviour before sending it for approval.
